coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Campaign operations teams often struggle with the same core problem: getting the right message to the right audience without things slipping through the cracks. During my marketing internship at Harbor Street Pet Supply, I worked on exactly that, writing and scheduling consistent email and social content each week and growing our newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers by rethinking how we captured sign-ups at the point of contact.

That experience taught me how much campaign performance depends on the operational details sitting behind the creative: audience targeting, timing, quality checks, and clear reporting. As Datadog's Marketing Operations Associate supporting the APJ team, I'd bring that same attention to the mechanics of execution. My work with Mailchimp and Hootsuite gave me a foundation in email and channel management, and my HubSpot Content Marketing certification reflects a genuine interest in learning how marketing automation platforms work at a deeper level. I'm also comfortable in Excel and Google Analytics, which I've used to track content performance and identify what's actually moving the needle. Managing the Westbrook Film Society's social channels across two platforms while coordinating with volunteers showed me how to keep multiple workstreams organized and meet deadlines when things are moving fast.

I'd welcome the chance to talk through how my background fits what the Campaign Operations team is building. I'm available at your convenience.

Sincerely,
Maya Linden
